Code printer objects

Source: R/codegen-printer-base.R, R/codegen-printer-c.R, R/codegen-printer-fortran.R, and 5 more
code-printer-objects.Rd

Printer objects after SymPy's code printer classes. C89CodePrinter(), C99CodePrinter() and C11CodePrinter() print C; CXX98CodePrinter(), CXX11CodePrinter() and CXX17CodePrinter() print C++; FCodePrinter() prints Fortran; PythonCodePrinter(), MpmathPrinter(), NumPyPrinter() and SciPyPrinter() print Python; JuliaCodePrinter(), OctaveCodePrinter(), RustCodePrinter() and JavascriptCodePrinter() print those languages. printer_doprint(p, e) prints an expression with a printer, as the doprint method does; the printer keeps what the printed code needs (headers, libraries, macros, module_imports), which ast_attr() reads.

Usage

printer_doprint(p, e, assign_to = NULL)

C89CodePrinter(settings = NULL)

C99CodePrinter(settings = NULL)

C11CodePrinter(settings = NULL)

CXX98CodePrinter(settings = NULL)

CXX11CodePrinter(settings = NULL)

CXX17CodePrinter(settings = NULL)

FCodePrinter(settings = NULL)

JavascriptCodePrinter(settings = NULL)

JuliaCodePrinter(settings = NULL)

OctaveCodePrinter(settings = NULL)

PythonCodePrinter(settings = NULL)

MpmathPrinter(settings = NULL)

NumPyPrinter(settings = NULL)

SciPyPrinter(settings = NULL)

LambdaPrinter(settings = NULL)

RCodePrinter(settings = NULL)

RustCodePrinter(settings = NULL)

Arguments

p

A printer.

e

An expression or codegen node.

assign_to

Optional variable to assign to.

settings

A named list of printer settings, such as list(type_aliases = ...) or list(standard = 95).

Value

A printer, or for printer_doprint() a character scalar.

Examples

x <- Symbol("x")
p <- C99CodePrinter()
printer_doprint(p, sym_expm1(x))
#> [1] "expm1(x)"
printer_doprint(FCodePrinter(list(source_format = "free")), x^2)
#> [1] "x**2"
